levels.title: Wilds Heart Beacon
levels.tagline: A living beacon choir sleeps in the roots of a storm-lit basin.
levels.goal: Wake the wild beacon choir and earn the Bridge Seed.
levels.story_beat: The wild district joins Mira’s journey and gifts her the Bridge Seed.
levels.reward: Upgrade earned: Bridge Seed.

landmarks.title: Choir Root
landmarks.description: The basin floor glows with roots that answer Mira’s steps.
landmarks.scene_detail: Root lights thread through the basin.
landmarks.journal_text: The basin floor glows with roots that answer Mira’s steps.

landmarks.title: Seed Vault
landmarks.description: The seed vault only opens when the true route family is identified.
landmarks.scene_detail: A root vault blocks the choir path.
landmarks.journal_text: The seed vault only opens when the true route family is identified.
landmarks.prompt: Which symbol belongs on the working route chart for Stormglass Wilds?
landmarks.hint: The correct answer marks movement, not damage or corruption.

landmarks.title: Choir Basin
landmarks.description: Sleeping beacons rise from the basin like flowers before dawn.
landmarks.scene_detail: A circle of living beacons waits in the dark.
landmarks.journal_text: The wild beacons look more like a choir than a machine.

landmarks.title: Root Oath
landmarks.description: The basin oath rejects the false route statement and waits for the contradiction to be exposed.
landmarks.scene_detail: A ring of roots tightens around the final lift.
landmarks.journal_text: The basin oath rejects the false route statement and waits for the contradiction to be exposed.
landmarks.prompt: Which statement contradicts the others at Root Oath?
answers: The route is lit and dark at the same time
landmarks.hint: Look for the claim that cannot stand beside the rest without breaking logic.

landmarks.title: Wilds Heart
landmarks.description: The beacon choir wakes together when Mira plants living flame in the basin.
landmarks.scene_detail: A chorus of green-white lights rises through the roots.
landmarks.journal_text: The wild beacon choir wakes and gifts Mira the Bridge Seed.

levels.title: Glass Ladder
levels.tagline: A ladder of broken glass decks climbs toward the dead observatory.
levels.goal: Re-enter the observatory district and stabilize its first shattered ascent.
levels.story_beat: The final district finally comes into view as a broken celestial machine.
levels.reward: The first observatory rung holds and opens the higher route.

landmarks.title: Rung Dock
landmarks.description: The first glass deck shivers as Mira steps onto it.
landmarks.scene_detail: Glass ladders climb toward the dark observatory shell.
landmarks.journal_text: The first glass deck shivers as Mira steps onto it.

landmarks.title: Wind Thread Hook
landmarks.description: The Wind Thread pulls a hidden cache from beneath a ladder rung.
landmarks.scene_detail: A hook hangs under a shattered step.
landmarks.journal_text: The Wind Thread exposes hidden caches in the observatory climb.

landmarks.title: Rung Sequence
landmarks.description: The broken ladder only rebuilds if its rung sequence is continued correctly.
landmarks.scene_detail: Glass rungs blink in cold rhythm.
landmarks.journal_text: The broken ladder only rebuilds if its rung sequence is continued correctly.
landmarks.prompt: What signal completes the pulse pattern at Rung Sequence: lantern, bell, lantern, bell, ... ?
landmarks.hint: The route is asking for a simple repeat, not a trick ending.

landmarks.title: Shatter Step
landmarks.description: A cracked rung cuts charge from the lantern as Mira lands on it.
landmarks.scene_detail: One ladder span splinters underfoot.
landmarks.journal_text: A cracked rung cuts charge from the lantern as Mira lands on it.

landmarks.title: First Rung Beacon
landmarks.description: A cold observatory lamp wakes on the first stable rung.
landmarks.scene_detail: A blue-white lamp hangs over the climb.
landmarks.journal_text: The first observatory rung steadies and makes the high path real again.

levels.title: Hollow Orrery
levels.tagline: A gigantic empty orrery turns in silence around a missing center.
levels.goal: Cross the turning machine and restore its route orbit.
levels.story_beat: Mira sees the sky machine from inside and realizes it was built for travelers, not rulers.
levels.reward: The orrery turns with purpose again and aligns the next route.

landmarks.title: Orbit Ring
landmarks.description: The outer ring of the orrery rotates under Mira’s feet.
landmarks.scene_detail: A giant ring path circles the machine.
landmarks.journal_text: The outer ring of the orrery rotates under Mira’s feet.

landmarks.title: Empty Center
landmarks.description: The orrery’s heart is missing, leaving the whole machine feeling abandoned instead of dead.
landmarks.scene_detail: The center of the machine is a hollow sky well.
landmarks.journal_text: The machine was designed for movement through it, not worship of it.

landmarks.title: Orbit Proof
landmarks.description: The orbit lock opens only for the strongest remaining conclusion.
landmarks.scene_detail: A rotating lock rides the inner ring.
landmarks.journal_text: The orbit lock opens only for the strongest remaining conclusion.
landmarks.prompt: The map shard, bell tone, and wind line all agree about one path in Hollow Orrery. What should Mira infer?
landmarks.hint: When independent clues agree, trust the overlap.

landmarks.title: Counterweight Split
landmarks.description: One counterweight is steady. The other hides a relic cache behind a failing track.
landmarks.scene_detail: Two weight tracks cut across the orrery shell.
landmarks.journal_text: One counterweight is steady. The other hides a relic cache behind a failing track.

choice.prompt: How should Mira cross the counterweights?

safe.label: Take the steady track
safe.outcome: Mira stays balanced and keeps the lantern line steady.
safe.journal_text: Mira uses the steady counterweight and saves charge for the core.

risky.label: Cut through the failing track
risky.outcome: The track coughs sparks and costs charge, but Mira tears a relic free from the hidden brace.
risky.journal_text: Mira raids the failing track for a relic and barely keeps balance.

landmarks.title: Axis Light
landmarks.description: The axis light restarts the orrery rotation in the right alignment.
landmarks.scene_detail: A pale axis lamp hangs over the hollow center.
landmarks.journal_text: The hollow orrery turns with purpose again and aligns the next route.

levels.title: Starwell Causeway
levels.tagline: A long causeway bridges several wells of cold starlight.
levels.goal: Cross the causeway and prove the final route logic in sequence.
levels.story_beat: Mira comes within reach of the Lantern Spine and the whole world’s missing center.
levels.reward: The causeway lights a direct line into the observatory heart.

landmarks.title: Well Gate
landmarks.description: The first starwell sits black and still beside the gate.
landmarks.scene_detail: A straight causeway runs above several star wells.
landmarks.journal_text: The first starwell sits black and still beside the gate.

landmarks.title: Well Statement
landmarks.description: The first well must reject the false route claim before it will shine.
landmarks.scene_detail: A frozen statement ring hangs above the well.
landmarks.journal_text: The first well must reject the false route claim before it will shine.
landmarks.prompt: Which report clashes with the confirmed route signs in High Observatory?
answers: The bridge is both restored and missing
landmarks.hint: A contradiction says mutually exclusive things are true together.

landmarks.title: Blue Cache
landmarks.description: A blue cache hidden in the side rail restores charge for the last approach.
landmarks.scene_detail: A narrow side rail hides a cold reserve lamp.
landmarks.journal_text: A blue cache hidden in the side rail restores charge for the last approach.

landmarks.title: Causeway Lock
landmarks.description: The causeway lock obeys only when its final condition is interpreted correctly.
landmarks.scene_detail: A pale lock glows in the center of the bridge.
landmarks.journal_text: The causeway lock obeys only when its final condition is interpreted correctly.
landmarks.prompt: If the wind gate opens only when the lantern is lit, and the lantern is lit, what follows at Causeway Lock?
landmarks.hint: Apply the condition directly. Do not add extra assumptions.

landmarks.title: Causeway Core
landmarks.description: The causeway core ignites and opens the final observatory approach.
landmarks.scene_detail: A star-fed lantern waits above the last well.
landmarks.journal_text: The causeway opens the direct line into the observatory heart.

levels.title: Moon Reservoir
levels.tagline: The observatory keeps an entire reservoir of reflected night in one suspended bowl.
levels.goal: Restore the reservoir and hold enough charge for the final climb.
levels.story_beat: Mira chooses restoration over control before she even reaches the end.
levels.reward: The reservoir fills with honest light and steadies the final ascent.

landmarks.title: Reservoir Lip
landmarks.description: The bowl edge hums with old moonlight.
landmarks.scene_detail: A curved stone lip circles the suspended reservoir.
landmarks.journal_text: The bowl edge hums with old moonlight.

landmarks.title: Night Bowl
landmarks.description: The whole reservoir reflects a sky the world has almost forgotten.
landmarks.scene_detail: Dark water shines with pale stars.
landmarks.journal_text: The observatory saved night itself in a bowl of still water.

landmarks.title: Mirror Rail
landmarks.description: A safe rail follows the rim. A broken mirror rail hides a relic behind falling glass.
landmarks.scene_detail: Two rails cut across the bowl edge.
landmarks.journal_text: A safe rail follows the rim. A broken mirror rail hides a relic behind falling glass.

choice.prompt: How should Mira approach the final lock?

safe.label: Follow the rim rail
safe.summary: Keep charge for the last level.
safe.outcome: The rim rail holds and Mira keeps the lantern flame steady.
safe.journal_text: Mira chooses endurance over greed at the reservoir.

risky.label: Cross the mirror rail
risky.summary: One last relic, one last risk.
risky.outcome: The mirror rail shatters underfoot, but Mira steals a relic from its center before escaping.
risky.journal_text: Mira takes one last greedy path before the final ascent.

landmarks.title: Night Seal
landmarks.description: The reservoir seal accepts only the strongest last deduction before the spine.
landmarks.scene_detail: A blue-white seal floats above the water.
landmarks.journal_text: The reservoir seal accepts only the strongest last deduction before the spine.
landmarks.prompt: Which conclusion is strongest at Night Seal if every live route in view points toward the same tower?
answers: That tower is the true destination
landmarks.hint: Choose the answer supported by all the visible evidence, not the most dramatic one.

landmarks.title: Reservoir Crown
landmarks.description: The crown fills the bowl with honest light and steadies Mira’s final ascent.
landmarks.scene_detail: A silver crown lantern rests on the bowl center.
landmarks.journal_text: The reservoir fills with honest light and prepares the way to the Lantern Spine.

levels.title: Lantern Spine
levels.tagline: The world’s central route hangs shattered over the empty sky.
levels.goal: Relight the Lantern Spine and return the world to motion.
levels.story_beat: Mira does not conquer the world machine. She walks it back to life.
levels.reward: Upgrade earned: Spine Flame.

landmarks.title: Spine Threshold
landmarks.description: The final threshold opens over empty air where all districts meet.
landmarks.scene_detail: The broken spine stretches into the white distance.
landmarks.journal_text: The final threshold opens over empty air where all districts meet.

landmarks.title: Memory Lattice
landmarks.description: The spine lattice reorders only when the true route family is named.
landmarks.scene_detail: A giant lattice of lantern sockets turns in the void.
landmarks.journal_text: The spine lattice reorders only when the true route family is named.
landmarks.prompt: Which item should Mira file into the safe travel drawer for Lantern Spine?
landmarks.hint: Only one answer sounds like something a routekeeper would deliberately preserve.

landmarks.title: Silent World
landmarks.description: From the spine Mira can see every relit district waiting for the last bridge.
landmarks.scene_detail: All four districts glow below the final route.
landmarks.journal_text: Mira sees the whole world waiting below the final bridge.

landmarks.title: Quiet Break
landmarks.description: The final break in the spine only yields when The Quiet’s false route is exposed.
landmarks.scene_detail: A pale seam of silence blocks the last light well.
landmarks.journal_text: The final break in the spine only yields when The Quiet’s false route is exposed.
landmarks.prompt: Which report clashes with the confirmed route signs in High Observatory?
answers: The bridge is both restored and missing
landmarks.hint: A contradiction says mutually exclusive things are true together.

landmarks.title: Spine Flame
landmarks.description: The world’s central lantern wakes and the whole sky map moves again.
landmarks.scene_detail: A colossal lantern opens like dawn over the empty sky.
landmarks.journal_text: The Lantern Spine relights, the routes return, and Mira chooses a world open to travelers.
